reason: I can see the pain: finding a good builder for a flat is a nightmare and I have no evenings to chase crews. But my first instinct is to pay the crew directly and skip the middleman, and a platform that sits between me and the builder and holds my money looks like an extra layer that takes a cut. I would need to read real reviews of the builders before I trusted anything on it.
objection: Who is really making money here, and why would I pay you on top of the builder's price when I could find and vet a crew myself? If the builders on it are just whoever paid for placement, I am back to distrusting it.
would_change_my_mind: Verified builders with independent, checkable reviews from past private clients in my city, a fixed fee I can see before I sign, and a payment arrangement where my money is released only as the agreed work is signed off.
